style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the whole is a square of milk chocolate, so the keys are chocolate brown and Enter is the berry treat of the same world

images.why: Look: 'a row of hundred grids, one for each whole' and Stage: 'each labelled Whole and 100%'. A hundred grid is one whole (100 hundredths): one square of milk chocolate per grid, the 100 cells, outlines, fills and counts drawn in code over it (a grid is past 40 skins a screen, so never one skin per cell).
images.prompt: One single square of milk chocolate: a slightly rounded-square block with a raised bevelled edge (a lighter rim at the top left, a darker rim at the bottom right), a pressed-in inner panel, and a glossy highlight from light above, in a warm milk-chocolate brown.
